toolsPreview.name: get_business_context
toolsPreview.description: Get Gitsim product knowledge, pricing model, IP routing guidance, and eSIM fundamentals. Call this FIRST before helping a customer so you understand the product.

toolsPreview.name: search_packages
toolsPreview.description:
Search for eSIM data packages by country. Returns up to 10 packages per page sorted by price. Use the page parameter to paginate. No auth required. Call get_business_context first to understand IP routing and package types.

Package types:
- "regular": Fixed data pool (e.g. 3GB for 30 days). Best for most travelers.
- "daily": Data resets each day (e.g. 2GB/day for 5 days). Good for short trips with predictable daily usage. Top-up days are available.

IP routing (important for Asia):
- "breakout": Local IP in destination country. Best for streaming, banking, social media. ALWAYS recommend by default.
- "hk": Hong Kong IP. Cheapest but TikTok app and Facebook app are BLOCKED.
- "nonhk": Third-country IP (UK, Singapore). No HK restrictions but IP won't match destination.

toolsPreview.name: get_package
toolsPreview.description: Get details for a specific eSIM package by its ID. No authentication required.

toolsPreview.name: create_order
toolsPreview.description: Create an order for an eSIM package. Returns a Stripe checkout URL where the user can pay. Requires a session key (from a previous tool call's structuredContent) or creates one automatically.

toolsPreview.name: check_order_status
toolsPreview.description: Check the status of the most recent order. Requires a session key from a previous tool call.

toolsPreview.name: list_esims
toolsPreview.description: List the customer's delivered eSIMs. Requires a session key from a previous tool call.

toolsPreview.name: check_data_balance
toolsPreview.description: Check remaining data balance on an eSIM. Requires a session key and the eSIM's ICCID.

toolsPreview.name: search_topup_packages
toolsPreview.description: Find compatible top-up packages for an existing eSIM. Requires a session key and the eSIM's ICCID.

toolsPreview.name: buy_topup
toolsPreview.description: Purchase a top-up data package for an existing eSIM. Returns a Stripe checkout URL.
